title: DF3DV-1K: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Distractor-Free Novel View Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2604.13416v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Advances in radiance fields have enabled photorealistic novel view synthesis. In several domains, large-scale real-world datasets have been developed to support comprehensive benchmarking and to facilitate progress beyond scene-specific reconstruction. However, for distractor-free radiance fields, a large-scale dataset with clean and cluttered images per scene remains lacking, limiting the development. To address this gap, we introduce DF3DV-1K, a large-scale real-world dataset comprising 1,048 scenes, each providing clean and cluttered image sets for benchmarking. In total, the dataset contains 89,924 images captured using consumer cameras to mimic casual capture, spanning 128 distractor types and 161 scene themes across indoor and outdoor environments. translated_title: DF3DV-1K：用于无干扰新颖视角合成的大规模数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 辐射场技术的进步已实现了逼真的新颖视角合成。在多个领域中，大规模真实世界数据集已被开发，以支持全面的基准测试，并促进超越特定场景重建的进展。然而，对于无干扰辐射场，目前仍缺乏一个每场景同时包含干净和杂乱图像的大规模数据集，这限制了其发展。为解决这一空白，我们引入了DF3DV-1K，这是一个大规模真实世界数据集，包含1,048个场景，每个场景提供干净和杂乱的图像集用于基准测试。该数据集总计包含89,924张图像，使用消费级相机拍摄以模拟随意采集，覆盖128种干扰类型和161种场景主题，涵盖室内和室外环境。此外，我们精心设计了一个包含41个场景的子集DF3DV-41，用于评估无干扰辐射场方法在挑战性场景下的鲁棒性。基于DF3D方法进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了DF3DV-1K，一个包含1,048个场景、89,924张图像的大规模真实世界数据集，专门用于无干扰新颖视角合成的基准测试，并设计了DF3DV-41子集以评估鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DF3DV-1K, a large-scale real-world dataset with 1,048 scenes and 89,924 images for benchmarking distractor-free novel view synthesis, including a curated DF3DV-41 subset for robustness evaluation.
